rationale: The agent appears to have cancelled the entire order without first confirming that action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm any order-changing write. The user’s primary request was to try splitting payment; if not possible, ask about removing the most expensive item or switching to cheaper options, and only then cancel as a last resort. The conversation shows no attempt to address split payment, item-level changes, or to hand off to a human if those were not supported. The cancellation reason recorded (“ordered by mistake”) also does not match the user’s stated situation. While tools were listed, there is no visible confirmation step before the cancel, and the agent provided refund and card details without evidenced tool outputs in the transcript. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
